content.thinking: All top-level, trace, and config invalid tests pass. Now let me test event/packet/frame validation.

arguments.command:
cat > /app/tmp/t/test_invalid2.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/tmp/t")
from run import expect_invalid

ok = True
def V(traces): return {"version": 1, "traces": traces}
CFG = {
    "early": False, "overlap": "reject", "buffer_packets": 2, "idle_ms": 0,
    "max_streams_bidi": 4, "max_streams_uni": 4, "max_stream_data": 32,
    "max_data": 64, "crypto_limit": 32, "sent": {"I": [], "H": [], "A": []},
}
def tr(events): return {"id": "t", "config": CFG, "events": events}
def S(o): return json.dumps(V(o)).encode()
def key(t, level, action): return {"t": t, "op": "key", "level": level, "action": action}
def dg(t, size, pkts): return {"t": t, "op": "datagram", "bytes": size, "packets": pkts}
def pkt(level, pn, auth, frames): return {"level": level, "pn": pn, "auth": auth, "frames": frames}

cases = [
 # events
 ("event missing t", S([tr([{"op":"tick"}])])),
 ("event missing op", S([tr([{"t":0}])])),
 ("event extra key", S([tr([{"t":0,"op":"tick","x":1}])])),
 ("tick with level", S([tr([{"t":0,"op":"tick","level":"I"}])])),
 ("t negative", S([tr([{"t":-1,"op":"tick"}])])),
 ("t too big", S([tr([{"t":1000000000001,"op":"tick"}])])),
 ("t bool", S([tr([{"t":True,"op":"tick"}])])),
 ("t decreasing", S([tr([{"t":5,"op":"tick"},{"t":4,"op":"tick"}])])),
 ("t equal ok but op bad", S([tr([{"t":5,"op":"bogus"}])])),
 ("op not string", S([tr([{"t":0,"op":1}])])),
 ("key bad level", S([tr([key(0,"X","install")])])),
 ("key bad action", S([tr([key(0,"I","reinstall")])])),
 ("key missing action", S([tr([{"t":0,"op":"key","level":"I"}])])),
 ("key extra", S([tr([{"t":0,"op":"key","level":"I","action":"install","x":1}])])),
 ("level lowercase", S([tr([key(0,"i","install")])])),
 # datagram
 ("datagram missing bytes", S([tr([{"t":0,"op":"datagram","packets":[pkt("I",0,True,[])]}])])),
 ("bytes negative", S([tr([dg(0,-1,[pkt("I",0,True,[])])])])),
 ("bytes 65536", S([tr([dg(0,65536,[pkt("I",0,True,[])])])])),
 ("bytes bool", S([tr([dg(0,True,[pkt("I",0,True,[])])])])),
 ("packets empty", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[])])])),
 ("packets 17", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",i,True,[]) for i in range(17)])])])),
 ("packets not list", S([tr([dg(0,1200,{"a":1})])])),
 # packets
 ("packet not object", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[1])])])),
 ("packet missing frames", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[{"level":"I","pn":0,"auth":True}])])])),
 ("packet extra key", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[{"level":"I","pn":0,"auth":True,"frames":[],"x":1}])])])),
 ("packet bad level", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("Q",0,True,[])])])])),
 ("pn negative", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",-1,True,[])])])])),
 ("pn too big", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",4611686018427387904,True,[])])])])),
 ("pn bool", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",True,True,[])])])])),
 ("auth int", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,1,[])])])])),
 ("auth null", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,None,[])])])])),
 ("frames not list", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,{})])])])),
 ("frames 65", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"PADDING"}]*65)])])])),
 ("frame not object", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[1])])])),
 ("frame missing type", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{}])])])),
 ("frame unknown name", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"BOGUS"}])])])),
 ("frame type not str", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":1}])])])),
 ("padding extra key", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"PADDING","x":1}])])])),
 ("ping extra", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"PING","id":0}])])])),
 ("ack missing ranges", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"ACK"}])])])),
 ("ack ranges not list", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"ACK","ranges":{}}])])])),
 ("ack 33 ranges", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"ACK","ranges":[[i,i] for i in range(33)]}])])])),
 ("ack range bad endpoint", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"ACK","ranges":[[0,4611686018427387904]]}])])])),
 ("ack range negative", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"ACK","ranges":[[-1,0]]}])])])),
 ("ack range 1 elem", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"ACK","ranges":[[1]]}])])])),
 ("ack range 3 elem", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"ACK","ranges":[[1,2,3]]}])])])),
 ("crypto missing offset", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","data_hex":""}])])])),
 ("crypto offset big", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":4611686018427387904,"data_hex":""}])])])),
 ("crypto hex odd", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"a"}])])])),
 ("crypto hex upper", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"AA"}])])])),
 ("crypto hex nonhex", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"zz"}])])])),
 ("crypto hex 2049 bytes", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"ab"*2049}])])])),
 ("crypto hex not string", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":123}])])])),
 ("crypto hex null", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":None}])])])),
 ("stream missing fin", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"STREAM","id":0,"offset":0,"data_hex":""}])])])),
 ("stream id big", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"STREAM","id":4611686018427387904,"offset":0,"data_hex":"","fin":False}])])])),
 ("stream fin int", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"STREAM","id":0,"offset":0,"data_hex":"","fin":0}])])])),
 ("stream extra", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"STREAM","id":0,"offset":0,"data_hex":"","fin":False,"x":1}])])])),
 ("reset missing fs", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"RESET_STREAM","id":0}])])])),
 ("reset fs big", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"RESET_STREAM","id":0,"final_size":4611686018427387904}])])])),
 ("stop missing id", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"STOP_SENDING"}])])])),
 ("close missing code", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"CLOSE","app":False}])])])),
 ("close app int", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"CLOSE","app":1,"code":0}])])])),
 ("close code big", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"CLOSE","app":False,"code":4611686018427387904}])])])),
 ("close code neg", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"CLOSE","app":False,"code":-1}])])])),
 ("handshake_done extra", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("A",0,True,[{"type":"HANDSHAKE_DONE","x":1}])])])),
 ("unknown extra", S([tr([dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"UNKNOWN","x":1}])])])),
]
for name, raw in cases: ok &= expect_invalid(name, raw)

# structural totals
ok &= expect_invalid("20001 events", S([{"id":"t","config":CFG,"events":[{"t":0,"op":"tick"}]*20001}]))
pk = pkt("I",0,True,[])
ok &= expect_invalid("20001 packets", S([{"id":"t","config":CFG,"events":[dg(0,1200,[pk]*16)] + [dg(1,1200,[pk]*16)]*1249 + [dg(2,1200,[pk])]}]))
# 16*1249 = 19984 + 16 = 20000, then +1 = 20001
ok &= expect_invalid("60001 frames", S([{"id":"t","config":CFG,"events":[dg(0,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"PADDING"}]*60)]*16)] + [dg(1,1200,[pkt("I",1,True,[{"type":"PADDING"}]*40)])]}]))
# 60*16=960 + 40 = 1000 ... need 60001: use many packets
evs = []
n = 0
for i in range(1000):
    evs.append(dg(i,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"PADDING"}]*60)]))
    n += 60
# 60000 frames exactly -> valid; add one more
evs.append(dg(1000,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"PADDING"}])]))
ok &= expect_invalid("60001 frames v2", S([{"id":"t","config":CFG,"events":evs}]))
# 2MiB+1 decoded data
big = "ab"*2048
evs = []
n = 0
i = 0
while n <= 2*1024*1024:
    evs.append(dg(i,1200,[pkt("I",0,True,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":big}])]))
    n += 2048
    i += 1
ok &= expect_invalid("too much data", S([{"id":"t","config":CFG,"events":evs}]))
print("data events:", len(evs), n)
print("ALL PASS" if ok else "SOME FAILED")
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp/t && python3 test_invalid2.py
